_comment: The field tier (Tier 2) as shipped; implementation in proxima/field_tier.py, drivers in analysis/.

corpus.rows: k=5 nominal executions + M=100 replays of every training scenario, each labelled with the scenario's Tier-1 harm

ordering.survivors: 1 + rank(p) + rank(log) + rank(raw) on openpilot; 1 + rank(log) + rank(raw) on TransFuser (whose driver selects tau per fold on its training scenarios, max inner-OOF rank correlation)

magnitude.conformal: split conformal, calibration = 25% of the training scenarios, coverage 0.90, seeds 3

escalation.harm_score: 3 + mean injury of the b replays

protocol.bootstrap: 4000 scenario resamples, each also drawing one CV repeat
